recipe.visualDefinition: A three-person portrait set against a vanishing-point roadway, framed by a collage of vintage maps, distressed borders, and a prominent rectangular header block containing technical-style diagrams and display typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject trio in high-contrast black against a desaturated, sepia-toned landscape.
Geometric header block at the top center acting as a focal weight.
Layered botanical and map textures framing the central photographic scene.
Vanishing point of the road aligned with the central figure's head.
coreInvariants: Overlaid vintage map topography in the background sky area
High-contrast black silhouettes for the subjects

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three figures positioned mid-ground, full-body to waist-up, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A dark red rectangular block at the top center containing white technical illustrations and text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the top header, follows the road's perspective down to the central figure, then moves outward to the flanking figures and the textured corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper sky area is filled with map textures, while the road provides a light-colored negative space behind the dark subjects.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sepia and warm beige (background, skin tones, maps)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the black clothing and the bleached road surface.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serifs and monospaced technical fonts
letterConstructionRules: Display text uses heavy, blocky slab serifs with inline or outlined details
Secondary text uses clean, sans-serif or typewriter-style monospaced fonts
Small metadata text is tightly tracked and justified
characterSpecificRedesigns: Inline white stroke within heavy slab serif characters for the main title
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy decorative slab serif for the main title paired with utilitarian monospaced fonts for technical details.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, traditional western slab serif feel.
Provides the technical, monospaced metadata look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a sepia-toned photographic scene of three women in black dresses standing on a long, straight road that recedes into a vanishing point. Overlay the sky with a faint, orange-tinted vintage map texture. Add dark, distressed, burnt-paper edges and botanical leaf silhouettes in the bottom corners.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a dark red rectangular box at the top center with a double-line white border. Inside the box, place a large slab-serif title with an inline white stroke, a row of small stars, a technical scale bar, and a white line-art drawing of a house. Add a secondary title in the bottom right using bold, outlined sans-serif characters.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette predominantly sepia and black?
Does the header block contain technical/diagrammatic elements?
Is the map texture visible but not overpowering in the sky?
Are the subjects wearing high-contrast black clothing?

adjustableVariables: Complexity of the technical diagrams in the header
Amount of distressing on the borders
mustRedesign: Original band name and album title

mustAchieve: Clear visual hierarchy centered on the header and subjects

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the road vanishing point is centered.
Check that the red header block is perfectly centered horizontally.
Verify the distressed edges look organic and not like a simple filter.
Confirm the map overlay is restricted to the upper half of the image.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Sepia Roadside Photography] + [Vintage Map Overlays] + [Technical Diagram Header Block] + [Distressed Border Textures] to create a nostalgic Americana aesthetic.
